newsitem.title: CANADA: Bombardier plans C$300 mln debentures.
newsitem.headline: Bombardier plans C$300 mln debentures.

text.p: Bombardier Inc said on Monday that it planned to file a prospectus in Canada for an offering of C$300 million of debentures.

The offering would consist of C$150 million of debentures bearing interest at the rate of 7.35 percent a year to yield 7.366 percent and maturing on December 22, 2026, and C$150 million of debentures bearing interest at the rate of 6.40 percent a year to yield 6.437 percent and maturing on December 22, 2026.
The company said it would use proceeds from the sale of the debentures to reduce its short-term borrowings.
